description.value:
Cast 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Cost 6 Vitae

Duration 1 hour

You saw what it could do, and then you had a look at how.

Choose one creature you have touched, dissected or grafted within the last day. You gain one of its physical special abilities — a Speed, a sense, a natural weapon, or a resistance — for the duration, at the values it has. You cannot gain spellcasting, regeneration, or any ability that keys off a body you do not have.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element dynamically imports an arbitrary creature's ability profile (Speed, sense, natural weapon, resistance) onto the caster -- this is a GM-adjudicated, per-use grant with no fixed number to encode.
